earnings.title: LOEWS CORPORATION REPORTS NET INCOME OF $306 MILLION
highlights: Loews Corporation reported net income of $306 million, or $1.50 per share, in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $504 million, or $2.43 per share, in the third quarter of 2025.

Boardwalk Pipelines’ net income decreased year-over-year primarily due to higher operating expenses, including $14 million (after-tax) of charges related to net unrealized losses at Continuum and an impairment charge associated with the relocation of Boardwalk’s corporate office.
Net income attributable to Loews Corporation $ 306 $ 504 $ 1,087 $ 1,265
Net income per share attributable to Loews Corporation $ 1.50 $ 2.43 $ 5.29 $ 6.03
Net income attributable to Loews Corporation is $180 million compared to $371 million.

items.group: Risks Related to Us and Our Subsidiary, CNA

items.heading: CNA is vulnerable to material losses from natural and man-made disasters.
CNA has exposure related to A&EP claims, which could result in material losses.
CNA faces intense competition in its industry; it may be adversely affected by the cyclical nature of the property and casualty business and by the evolving landscape of its distribution network.

CNA’s underwriting strategies currently rely on the effectiveness of reinsurance arrangements and CNA accordingly faces risks relating to reinsurance, including obtaining reinsurance at a cost or on terms and conditions it deems acceptable, reinsurance counterparty risk and ineffective reinsurance coverage.
